line: The bridge and last chorus of hoy neo's song 风吹新竹, drawn frame by frame: two friends in two cities, a suitcase packed with home, a gust of wind on the chorus, a night street of lighting windows, and the word 家 (home) slammed down in the last lit one.
line_cn: hoy neo《风吹新竹》的桥段和最后一遍副歌，一格一格画出来：两个朋友在两座城市，行李箱里装进家乡，副歌一阵风吹过，夜街的窗一扇扇亮起，最后一扇亮着的窗里砸下一个「家」字。
uses: A lyric video for your own song, whole or a chorus: every line typed onto something in the picture
A poem, slogan or narration written onto the places and things it names
A city, campus or brand story told in collage type and flat cel drawings
